points.description: States the purpose: the test of level of significance checks how well the predicted/fitted model fits the observed data (goodness of fit).
States why it is important: it gives the probability of rejecting the null hypothesis using a statistical test (level of significance relates to rejecting the null hypothesis).
Names the chi-square (χ2) test as the test used.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the goodness-of-fit purpose, the link to the probability of rejecting the null hypothesis, and the chi-square (χ2) test named. Vague statements such as "to check accuracy" or "to see if data is reliable" earn nothing for P1 or P2. Naming any other test (t-test, F-test, Kolmogorov-Smirnov, etc.) as the answer earns 0 for P3, and a wrong extra test named alongside chi-square also loses P3.
